text: In schedule salary, under nature of perquisites, income is given more than once against one dropdown, under each block.
In schedule salary, under profit in lieu of salary, income is given more than once against one dropdown, under each block.
In Schedule salary, Income from retirement benefit account maintained in a notified country u/s 89A is not equal to sum of amounts of income entered against individual
country. In Schedule other sources, Income from retirement benefit account maintained in a notified country u/s 89A is not equal to sum of amounts of income entered against
individual country. In schedule Part B-TI, Income offered in Capital gain chargeable @ 30% u/s 115BBH, is not matching with Sl. No. C2 of Sch CG
Amount of "Total Capital Gains" is not equal to sum of Sl. No. 3c 'Sum of Short- term/Long-term capital gains' & 3d 'Capital gain chargeable @ 30% u/s 115BBH'.
If Old tax regime is selected, then value in the field "Rebate u/s 87A" should not be more than Rs.12,500.
In Schedule Part B-TI, Income disclosed in Short term chargeable @20% should be equal to Sl.no. 8ii of Table E in Schedule CG.
In Schedule Part B-TI, Income disclosed in Long term chargeable @12.5% should be equal to Sl.no. 8vi of Table E in Schedule CG.
Tax Payable on deemed total Income u/s 115JC in Part B TTI should be equal to the tax ascertained at Schedule AMT
In Schedule Part B-TTI, tax payments claimed should be equal to the claims made in Schedule TDS/TCS/IT.
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Total Tax Payable on Deemed Total Income u/s 115JC should be equal to (tax Payable on Deemed Income + Surcharge + Cess) 57
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Tax Payable on Total Income should be equal to (Normal Tax + Special Tax - Rebate on Agricultural Income).
In Schedule Part B-TTI, The amount at "Tax payable" should be equal to the amount of [Tax Payable on Total Income - Rebate u/s 87A]
In Schedule Part B-TTI, The amount at "Gross tax liability" should be equal to the sum of (Tax Payable, Surcharge & Education Cess)
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Relief claimed under section 90/90A should be equal to "Amount entered" in Schedule TR
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Relief claimed under section 91 should be equal to "Amount entered" in Schedule TR
In Schedule Part B-TTI, "Total Tax Relief" should be equal to sum of (Relief u/s 89, Relief u/s 90/90A and Relief u/s 91).
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Total Interest & fee Payable should be equal to "Interest & fee u/s 234A + 234B + 234C+234F+234-I"
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Aggregate liability should be equal to "Net tax liability" + "Total Interest & fee Payable"
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Total Taxes Paid should be equal to the sum of "Advance Tax, TDS, TCS & Self-Assessment Tax"
IFSC under “Bank Details” in Part BTTI and schedule 80G and schedule 80GGC should match with the RBI database
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Sl.No.2e Rebate u/s 87A is only allowed to Resident or Resident but not ordinary resident
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Sl.No.2e Rebate u/s. 87A is only allowed to Individual.
Rebate u/s 87A cannot be claimed by Individual Resident or Non Ordinarily Resident Individual having Total income more than Rs 5 lakhs and if Old Tax Regime is selected
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Refund claimed should match with the difference of “Total Taxes Paid” and “Aggregate Liability”.
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Tax payable Amount is not matching with the difference of “Aggregate Liability” and “Total Taxes Paid”.
In Schedule Part B-TI, Deemed income under section 115JC should be equal to Sl.no.3 of Schedule AMT
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Gross tax payable (higher of 1d and 2i) should be higher of Sl.No. 1d or 2i
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Tax payable after credit u/s 115JD (3a+3c-4) should be equal to sum of Sl.No. 3a+3c-4
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Net tax liability should be equal to Sl.No. 5 - 6D
Relief u/s 89 can be claimed only out of Income from salary or family pension 58
If "New Tax Regime" is selected and In Schedule Part B TTI, Sl.No. 1a to 1d should not be more than zero.
In Schedule Part B TTI, Sl.No. 3a + 3b should be equal to Sl.No.3.
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Sl.no 3 should be equal to Sl.no 3a+3b
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Sl. No. 10c "TCS" should be equal to the sum of column 7(i) of Schedule TCS
In Schedule Part B-TTI, Sl. No. 10b "TDS" should be equal to the sum of column 5 of TDS 1, column 9 of Schedule TDS 2 & Schedule TDS 3
Assessee with total income exceeding Rs. 12,00,000 subject to marginal relief (if any) cannot claim Rebate u/s 87A. Please refer to section 87A of Income tax act, 1961.
Maximum amount of Rebate should be computed as per the provisions of section 87A.
Fees for furnishing revised return under 234-I shall be equal to Rs. 1000 if ITR is filed after 31/12/2026 and filing section is 139(5) and total income does not exceed Rs. 5 lakh.
Fees for furnishing revised return under 234-I shall be equal to Rs. 5000 if ITR is filed after 31/12/2026 and filing section is 139(5) and total income exceeds Rs.5 lakh.
In Schedule EI, Sl.No. 5 Pass through income not chargeable to tax should be equal to the amount of exempt income mentioned in Schedule PTI
In Schedule EI, Sl.No. 6 should be equal to sum of Sl.No. 1+2(v)+3+4+5
In Schedule EI, Sl.No. 2v should be equal to sum of Sl. No. i-ii-iii+iv
In Schedule EI, Sl.No. 2(iv) Agricultural income portion relating to Rule 7, 7A, 7B(1), 7B(1A) and 8 should be equal to Sl.No. 38 of Schedule BP
In Schedule EI, If net agricultural income for the year exceeds Rs.5 lakh, details of each agriculture land should be filled.
If "New Tax Regime" is selected, then exempt income u/s 10(17)-Allowance MP/MLA/MLC cannot be claimed.
In "Schedule EI" ' Total income claimed as not chargeable to tax as per DTAA' at Sl. No, 4 should be equal to the total of amount entered in "Amount of Income"

In Schedule EI at Sl. No. 3, dropdowns of the same exemption should not be selected more than once. Exempt income u/s 10(4)(i), 10(4F), 10(4G), 10(4H), 10(6B), 10(6BB), 10(6D), 10(8A) and 10(23FF) cannot be reported by Residents Exempt income fields should be reported only for applicable sections and sub-categories In Schedule TDS2 and TDS3, If TDS b/f is claimed then year of tax deduction should be provided. 59
